title: Français 3622
contents: Arrangements to send money to Lyon and check Swiss muster rolls; a promised payment by the end of April and a mission to the aldermen of Lyon.
fields: 54 symbols: 39 letter signs, 1 double-letter sign, 14 in nomenclature
Original key in a different volume: Français 3995, ff122v–123r (Cryptiana no66). ·

excerpt: **facent monstre sur les vieu? rooles parce qu’il y va grand perte. Rasseure le Roy qui l’auroit le tout à la fyn d’avril selon que vous me dites.** Au demeurant, j’ay despesché aussy ? **Asdrubal vers le Corse et eschevyns de Lyon** pour l’affaire
translation: [They] muster on the old? rolls, because a great loss is at stake. Reassure the King that he would have everything by the end of April, as you tell me. Meanwhile, I have also sent ? Asdrubal to the Corsican and the aldermen of Lyon about the business.
